### AI Policy

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| **Has journal-specific AI policy?** | *(see summary — defaults to publisher-level policy unless a journal-specific override was found)* |
| **Explicit permission gate?** | conditional |
| **Leniency (1-5)** | 3 |
| **Summary** | No PPQ-specific AI policy page found; journal follows Wiley's publisher-wide Generative AI Guidelines (Sept 2023, updated 2025). AI/LLM tools may be used only as a writing companion (language/grammar polish, structural clarity, idea exploration, literature-search aid) — never for generating unverified manuscript content, data, or images. AI cannot be listed as author/co-author. Disclosure of tool name, version, and use is required (Acknowledgments or Methods). No evidence PPQ imposes a stricter or looser journal-specific rule on top of this. |
| **Source URL** | https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/pb-assets/assets/15405885/Generative%20AI%20Policy_September%202023-1695231878293.pdf |

**Current positioning (what the journal accepts now):** Mainstream analytic philosophy across core subfields: ethics/moral philosophy, epistemology, metaphysics, philosophy of mind and emotion, political philosophy, aesthetics, and history of philosophy (e.g. Spinoza, Quine). Recent (2025) content includes an Early View thematic cluster on 'Substructural Approaches to Paradox' (non-classical logic).

**Methods noted as welcome (qualitative — not a scored 0-5 table, see Methodological Preferences below):** analytic argumentative philosophy, formal/logical analysis (e.g. substructural logic, paradox), conceptual/metaphysical analysis, normative ethical theory, history-of-philosophy textual/critical analysis

- **experiential.desk_reject_pct**: Same as above — SciRev n/a, no first-hand forum data found in English or Chinese.
- **experiential.acceptance_note**: No first-hand author account found; only generic aggregator claims (e.g. Editage-style pages citing '15-20% acceptance, 3-4 months to decision') which are unsourced/derivative, not first-hand, so excluded per no-invented-numbers rule.
- **experiential.reviewer_culture**: No concrete first-hand source (forum post, review report account) found describing reviewer culture/political leaning; omitting rather than inferring from journal's general analytic-department affiliation (USC).
- **preprint.allowed**: Wiley's general Self-Archiving/preprint policy exists publisher-wide but the PPQ-specific for-authors page could not be fetched directly (HTTP 402 on onlinelibrary.wiley.com direct fetch); did not want to assert a journal-specific figure sourced only from a generic Wiley boilerplate without confirming it applies unmodified to this journal.
